concept.reason: Real holotype photo with scale and attributed same-taxon complete reconstruction are sufficient.

scope: Complete small Silurian trigonotarbid, anchored to Ulster Museum K25850 holotype and the same taxon scholarly whole-animal reconstruction. Rounded segmented abdomen, distinct triangular headshield, four articulated walking pairs and paired anterior palps; no spider waist or external tail.

scientific_limits.en: Body length about1.2mm is estimated from the published0.5mm scale bars, not a published caliper measurement. Fossil lacks complete appendages: restored limbs follow Dunlop1996 reconstruction as reproduced by JNCC, not direct preservation. Body depth, posture, subtle eyes and color are interpretive.
scientific_limits.zh: 体长约1.2毫米按公开0.5毫米图尺估计，非游标实测。化石附肢不完整，按JNCC转载Dunlop1996同种完整复原补配；不宣称化石全部保存。厚度、姿态、细小眼区及颜色为解释性推断。

scale.uncertainty: Approximate1.1–1.3mm body from two independent reproductions of0.5mm scale; choose1.2mm with~15% tolerance. Limbs follow reconstruction proportions, not fossil-measured lengths.

anatomy: Broad, oval abdomen widest anterior-middle and rounded posterior, attached broadly to triangular/subtriangular carapace with pointed anterior apex. No narrow spider pedicel.

Raised broad anterior abdominal tergite2–3 as labeled in source, then transverse abdominal plates with median and lateral subdivisions; terminal dorsal plate9 broad and undivided. Do not copy Trigonotarbus separate2/3 or pear-shaped posterior taper blindly.

Four pairs of articulated walking legs, two pairs directed anterior/outward and two lateral/posterior; long enough to match whole-animal drawing, not stumpy invented legs. Central anterior pair in reconstruction are palps, not fifth walking pair or antennae.
Small anterior mouthparts conservative beneath head; eyes only restrained low relief consistent with reconstruction, not large spider-like bulbous eyes.
No exposed external tail, spinnerets, wings, scorpion pincers or spiny armor. Ventral pygidium is not a tail. Fine setae/ornament may be omitted at lowpoly scale.
restoration_boundaries: Actual carbonized holotype photo in2022Fig1D viewed; correct panelD only, not neighboring myriapodE. Caption identifies UlsterMuseumK25850 and500µm scale.
JNCCFigure2.44a gives interpreted dorsal/ventral fossil, b complete reconstruction fromDunlop1996. Real photo confirms body silhouette; reconstructed limbs supply missing functional anatomy.
Palaeotarbus is replacement name for Eotarbus jerami; do not confuse with the earlier Carboniferous taxon bearing Eotarbus name.
The original rounded abdomen and headshield gate is retained; limb stoutness must follow actual published reconstruction rather than exaggeration.
Body depth/color/pose inferred. No claim this is a scan or exact preserved whole animal.
quality_gates: Whole animal with rounded plated abdomen and triangular carapace, not just fossil fragment.
Four walking pairs plus independent palps, no extra leg pair or antennae.
Tergite2–3 organization followsPalaeotarbus figure; do not reuseTrigonotarbus separate plates.
Scale and restored appendages explicitly separated from direct fossil evidence.
Four fixed views; no default extra renders.
